description: This file defines a Java interface 'MatriculaRepository' extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository, providing methods for querying 'Matricula' entities based on 'Curso' and 'User' objects within a learning platform project.

classes.name: MatriculaRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data repository interface providing custom query methods for 'Matricula' entities.

methods.name: findAllByCurso
methods.description: Returns a list of 'Matricula' entities associated with the specified 'Curso'.

methods.name: findAllByUsuario
methods.description: Returns a list of 'Matricula' entities associated with the specified 'User'.

methods.name: findByCursoAndUsuario
methods.description: Finds a 'Matricula' entity matching both the specified 'Curso' and 'User'.
